newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian tin falls further, other metals steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian tin falls further, other metals steady.

text.p: Prices of tin fell further on Tuesday for want of demand while other base metals held steady in dull trade, dealers said.
Tin lost 200 rupees to 30,900 rupees per quintal (100 kg) as industrial consumers stayed away from the market. Tin fell 300 rupees per quintal on Monday.
Nickel was steady at 36,300 rupees per quintal. Copper and aluminium were unchanged at 13,750 rupees per quintal and 7,700 rupees per quintal respectively.
Dealers said sentiment was weak and only a revival in state agencies' demand for non-ferrous metals could cheer the market.
